meta_description: Southside Plastering in Bristol. Professional plastering, skimming, and render work. Free quotes, fast turnaround. Call 07774 044220 today.
hero_subhead: From cracked walls to full room finishes, we deliver smooth, durable results on time and within budget across Bristol.
services_subhead: Whether you need repair work, skimming, rendering, or full room finishes, we handle the lot with care and precision.

services.title: Internal Skimming & Finishing
services.desc: Fresh plaster finishes to tired walls and ceilings. We create smooth, paint-ready surfaces that transform tired rooms and hide imperfections.

services.title: Crack Repair & Patching
services.desc: Quick fixes for cracks, holes, and water damage. Most small jobs completed same day, with no mess left behind.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: New partition walls, ceiling repairs, and dry-lining work. We cut, fit, and finish to building regulation standards.

services.title: External Render & Harling
services.desc: Weather-resistant external finishes that protect your home and boost kerb appeal. Available in a range of finishes and colours.

services.title: Artex Removal & Re-Skimming
services.desc: Remove dated Artex ceilings and replace with modern smooth finishes. Safe asbestos-aware methods throughout.

services.title: Commercial Plasterwork
services.desc: Office refits, retail spaces, and industrial projects completed to schedule. We work evenings and weekends to fit around your business.

about_pullquote: We finish every job like it's our own home — no cutting corners, no stress.
about_para_1: Southside Plastering was founded over a decade ago by a tradesman tired of seeing sloppy work overpriced and over-promised. We've built our reputation by turning up on time, finishing when we say we will, and leaving every site clean and tidy. Based in south Bristol, we now cover the whole city and surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we're honest about what's needed, give fixed quotes with no hidden charges, and answer the phone. We specialise in both rapid repair work and large-scale renovation projects — and we're equally proud of both.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had three rooms done — hallway, kitchen, and bedroom. The lads were brilliant, on time every day, and the finish is perfect. No mess, no faffing about. Will 100% use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Needed a crack repaired in my living room ceiling before we sold the house. Rang them Tuesday morning, they came out Wednesday afternoon, sorted it, and sanded everything smooth. Worth every penny and took all the stress away.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Quote was competitive and they stuck to it. Work was done faster than expected and the quality is really professional. Friendly bloke who communicated well throughout. Top marks.
reviews.author: David M.
